title: 第15章 被嫌弃的张天雪第16章 这药有问题
lines: 山贼会爆发内乱林辰并不关心，只是无心插柳而已。
这一次他的目的已经达到。
只需要远离即可。
只是，终究还是动了恻隐之心，救下了张天雪。
林辰自己也是无奈，但救都救了林辰也不至于后悔，而且只要注意，处处小心，应该不会被张天雪察觉出端倪。
林辰一路扛着张天雪飞奔，在石林之中穿梭，不断的变换方向。
那些山贼虽然也熟悉此地的地形，但还是被林辰甩开了。
趁着爆血丸的药力未消，林辰扛着张天雪消失在山坳之中。
天色渐晚，太阳开始落山，而山里密林丛生，早已经昏暗无比。
此地，已经靠近妖兽活动的区域，而夜晚往往是凶恶妖兽出没的时间，林辰并不想太过深入。
寻了个隐蔽的山洞，林辰打算今晚在这里休整，明早再离开。
至于张天雪。
明天就分道扬镳！
进了山洞，林辰将张天雪丢在地上，并无半点怜香惜玉，惹得张天雪痛呼一声，眼睛泪汪汪的，显然砸在地上有些疼。
“你就不能轻点吗，我是人，又不是货物？”
张天雪叫道。
有些气恼。
不过不敢高声说话，担心被人寻到。
林辰则没有理会。
救了张天雪是毫无必要的事情，林辰哪有心情管她？
丢下张天雪之后，林辰在地上放置了一块夜光石。
光芒昏暗，勉强能够视物而已。
而如此微弱光芒不会传到外面，倒不必担心因此引来多余的注视。
张天雪颇为委屈地坐在一边，她今天的确经历了太多磨难，而看到林辰摆放夜光石十分仔细小心，都没有拿来扔，就更是委屈起来。
“今晚抓紧时间恢复，明天你自己离开”
，林辰盘坐而下，开始运转九天斩神诀。
使用爆血丸的缘故，林辰此刻十分虚弱，必须尽快恢复过来才行！
闻言，张天雪大眼睛眨了眨，惊呼道：“你不送我回去吗？”
“不送”
，林辰冷硬地道。
张天雪有些惊讶。
毕竟当时她在绝望中发疯的呼救，已经许下诺言。
而那一刻林辰出手将她从山贼手中救出来，目的不言自明！
这一路上张天雪都在纠结，到底要不要履行承诺。
content_en:
Lin Chen didn't care if the bandits broke out into civil strife, he was just inserting it unintentionally.
This time his goal was achieved.
Just stay away.
However, he finally felt compassion and saved Zhang Tianxue.
Lin Chen himself was helpless, but he wouldn't regret saving Lin Chen, and as long as he paid attention and was careful at all times, Zhang Tianxue wouldn't notice any clues.
Lin Chen carried Zhang Tianxue all the way and flew through the stone forest, constantly changing directions.
Although the bandits were familiar with the terrain here, they were still thrown away by Lin Chen.
While the power of the blood-blasting pill was still lingering, Lin Chen carried Zhang Tianxue and disappeared into the mountain col.
It was getting late, the sun began to set, and the mountains were densely forested and already extremely dark.
This place is already close to the area where monsters are active, and night is often the time when vicious monsters appear. Lin Chen doesn't want to go too deep.
After finding a hidden cave, Lin Chen planned to rest here tonight and leave tomorrow morning.
As for Zhang Tianxue.
Let’s go our separate ways tomorrow!
After entering the cave, Lin Chen threw Zhang Tianxue on the ground without any pity. Zhang Tianxue screamed in pain, his eyes filled with tears, and it was obviously a bit painful when he hit the ground.
"Can't you be gentler? I'm a human being, not a commodity?"
Zhang Tianxue shouted.
Somewhat annoyed.
But I dare not speak loudly for fear of being found.
Lin Chen ignored it.
Saving Zhang Tianxue was unnecessary. How could Lin Chen be in the mood to care about her?
After leaving Zhang Tianxue behind, Lin Chen placed a luminous stone on the ground.
The light was dim, barely able to see.
And such a weak light will not be transmitted outside, so there is no need to worry about attracting unnecessary attention.
Zhang Tianxue sat aside feeling aggrieved. She had indeed gone through too many hardships today, and she felt even more aggrieved when she saw that Lin Chen placed the luminous stones very carefully and did not throw them away.
"Hurry up and recover tonight, and leave by yourself tomorrow."
, Lin Chen sat down cross-legged and began to run the Nine Heavens Killing God Technique.
Due to the use of blood-blasting pills, Lin Chen is very weak at the moment and must recover as soon as possible!
Hearing this, Zhang Tianxue blinked his big eyes and exclaimed: "Aren't you going to send me back?"
"Not sent"
, Lin Chen said coldly.
Zhang Tianxue was a little surprised.
After all, she had already made a promise when she frantically called for help in despair.
At that moment, Lin Chen took action to rescue her from the bandits, and the purpose was self-evident!
Along the way, Zhang Tianxue was struggling with whether to fulfill his promise or not.
